description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class named AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException, which is used to indicate that an authorization subject has been temporarily blocked due to too many claim requests. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException, providing methods for instantiation, JSON deserialization, and setting headers, as well as an internal builder class.

classes.name: AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an authorization subject has been temporarily blocked due to excessive claim requests. Contains static factory methods, JSON deserialization, header setting, and a builder internal class for constructing instances.

classes.name: AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException.Builder
classes.description: An internal static class providing a fluent API (builder pattern) for constructing instances of AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException. It sets default message and description, and implements doBuild to create new instances with specified headers.

methods.name: AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException.newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException with default headers.

methods.name: AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException from a given JSON object and headers. The JSON content is ignored in this implementation.

methods.name: AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException with the provided headers set.
